label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: Two modal dialogs (shipping country and cookie settings) opened at once; the cookie banner had no direct decline button, only Preferences then Reject All, and the country dialog stayed open after cookies were rejected until I found Close modal
The product list was empty in the page tree on first load (list items with no content) and only filled in after a second read, so a customer could think there were no products
Every product card has a Quick add button with the same name, so they can only be told apart by position, not by name; the product name is not in the button label
After Quick add the cart drawer opened with only a heading and no contents at first; the items appeared only on a second read, with no clear announcement that the item was added
Contact section has a pre-ticked newsletter checkbox (marketing emails opt-in) and the address field is a combobox with no label hint; card fields are inside iframes
